cards.example_en: A lorry delivered fresh vegetables to the shop.
cards.example_zh: 一辆货车把新鲜蔬菜送到了店里。
cards.explain_zh: lorry主要用于英式英语，美式英语通常用truck。

cards.example_en: We explored the west coast of Ireland by bicycle.
cards.example_zh: 我们骑自行车游览了爱尔兰西海岸。
cards.explain_zh: 可指国家或整座岛；北爱尔兰属于英国，不属于该国。

cards.example_en: He hit the nail with a hammer.
cards.example_zh: 他用锤子敲钉子。
cards.explain_zh: 既指指甲也指钉子；作动词表示用钉子固定。
cards.source: Word Atlas; existing QuizMario bilingual correction

cards.example_en: We shared a warm apple pie after dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭后，我们分着吃了一个热苹果派。
cards.explain_zh: pie指馅饼；“饼图”须说pie chart。

cards.example_en: We shared a warm apple pie after dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭后，我们分着吃了一个热苹果派。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Your new hairstyle really suits your round glasses.
cards.example_zh: 你的新发型和你的圆框眼镜真配。
cards.explain_zh: 可数名词，指剪出或梳出的整体发型。

cards.example_en: I left my workbook in my school bag.
cards.example_zh: 我把练习册落在书包里了。
cards.explain_zh: workbook侧重练习；textbook侧重讲解知识。

cards.example_en: We circled every adjective on the weather worksheet.
cards.example_zh: 我们在天气练习纸上圈出了每一个形容词。
cards.explain_zh: 形容词常放在名词前或系动词后，如a cold day。
cards.source: Word Atlas; existing QuizMario bilingual correction

cards.example_en: Our garden is small, but theirs has several trees.
cards.example_zh: 我们的花园很小，但他们的花园里有好几棵树。
cards.explain_zh: theirs独立使用，后不接名词，也不加撇号。

cards.example_en: The children raced to the playground after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭后，孩子们跑向了游乐场。
cards.explain_zh: 主要指儿童玩耍场所，不泛指专业体育场。

cards.example_en: Everyone came to the picnic, including our new neighbours.
cards.example_zh: 大家都来野餐了，包括我们的新邻居。
cards.explain_zh: including后接名词或代词；included通常放其后。

cards.example_en: My sister checks my spelling before I send emails.
cards.example_zh: 我发邮件前，姐姐会帮我检查拼写。
cards.explain_zh: 指拼写能力通常不可数；指具体拼法可数。

cards.example_en: Although digital tools can correct spelling, students still need to develop accurate writing skills.
cards.example_zh: 虽然数字工具可以纠正拼写，学生仍需培养准确书写的能力。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Our neighbour showed us how to make Korean dumplings.
cards.example_zh: 邻居教我们怎样包韩式饺子。
cards.explain_zh: Korean可指朝鲜半岛两国，具体含义看语境。

cards.example_en: We cooked an Indian curry for dinner last night.
cards.example_zh: 我们昨晚做了一道印度咖喱当晚餐。
cards.explain_zh: 首字母大写；指美洲原住民时宜用其自称。

cards.example_en: I packed my lunch and jacket in my backpack.
cards.example_zh: 我把午餐和外套装进了双肩背包。
cards.explain_zh: 指双肩背包；英式英语也常用rucksack。

cards.example_en: We watched a funny cartoon about a dancing penguin.
cards.example_zh: 我们看了一部关于跳舞企鹅的搞笑动画片。
cards.explain_zh: cartoon 可指动画片或单幅漫画；漫画书常用 comic。

cards.example_en: The naughty puppy dragged my slippers into the garden.
cards.example_zh: 那只淘气的小狗把我的拖鞋拖进了花园。
cards.explain_zh: 常用于小孩或宠物，通常不表示严重的恶行。

cards.example_en: We took the elevator because our bags were heavy.
cards.example_zh: 我们的包很重，所以我们乘了电梯。
cards.explain_zh: 电梯在美式英语中常用elevator，英式常用lift。

cards.example_en: She sliced a ripe melon for our picnic.
cards.example_zh: 她切了一个熟甜瓜，供我们野餐时吃。
cards.explain_zh: melon泛指甜瓜类；watermelon专指西瓜。

cards.example_en: She sliced a ripe melon for our picnic.
cards.example_zh: 她切了一个熟甜瓜，供我们野餐时吃。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We visited a well-known castle during our summer holiday.
cards.example_zh: 暑假期间，我们参观了一座著名的城堡。
cards.explain_zh: 名词前通常加连字符；表语位置通常写well known。

cards.example_en: The chef added fresh herbs to the steaming soup.
cards.example_zh: 厨师往热气腾腾的汤里加入了新鲜香草。
cards.explain_zh: chef 的 ch 发 /ʃ/；通常指餐馆或酒店的专业厨师。

cards.example_en: He wrapped a warm towel around his wet shoulders.
cards.example_zh: 他把一条温暖的毛巾裹在湿漉漉的肩膀上。
cards.explain_zh: 可数名词；paper towel指吸水纸巾，不是布毛巾。

cards.example_en: Wearing shoes that restrict toe movement may affect balance and contribute to foot problems over time.
cards.example_zh: 穿限制脚趾活动的鞋子可能影响平衡，长此以往还可能导致足部问题。
cards.explain_zh: 手指是finger，脚趾是toe；大脚趾用big toe。

cards.example_en: I found a penny underneath the sofa this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上我在沙发底下发现了一枚便士硬币。
cards.explain_zh: 英国金额复数用pence；指多枚硬币用pennies。

cards.example_en: For families on low incomes, every penny saved on energy bills can make a difference.
cards.example_zh: 对于低收入家庭，能源账单上省下的每一分钱都可能有所帮助。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I spread strawberry jam on my toast this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上我在吐司上抹了草莓酱。
cards.explain_zh: 果酱通常不可数；一次交通堵塞用a traffic jam。

cards.example_en: I spread strawberry jam on my toast this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上我在吐司上抹了草莓酱。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We arrived at the theatre just before the play started.
cards.example_zh: 我们在话剧开演前刚好赶到了剧院。
cards.explain_zh: 英式拼写theatre，美式常写theater；英式电影院用cinema。

cards.example_en: My cousin moved to Denmark to study architecture.
cards.example_zh: 我的表亲搬到丹麦去学习建筑。
cards.explain_zh: 国名前通常不加the；丹麦人为Dane。

cards.example_en: Our apartment is on the eighth floor of this building.
cards.example_zh: 我们的公寓在这栋楼的八楼。
cards.explain_zh: 序数词前通常用the；eighth末尾的th发/θ/。

cards.example_en: Our apartment is on the eighth floor of this building.
cards.example_zh: 我们的公寓在这栋楼的八楼。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My bag fell open, but luckily nothing dropped out.
cards.example_zh: 我的包掉下来摔开了，幸好没有东西掉出来。
cards.explain_zh: 常修饰整个句子，放句首时通常后接逗号。

cards.example_en: Lina felt shy when she joined the new club.
cards.example_zh: 莉娜刚加入这个新社团时有些害羞。
cards.explain_zh: shy away from后接名词或动名词，表示回避。

cards.example_en: I squeezed half a lemon over the grilled fish.
cards.example_zh: 我把半个柠檬的汁挤在烤鱼上。
cards.explain_zh: 整个柠檬可数；lemon juice中的juice不可数。

cards.example_en: Adding lemon juice to meals can improve flavour without increasing the amount of salt consumed.
cards.example_zh: 在餐食中加入柠檬汁可以增添风味，而不增加盐的摄入量。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My laptop fits neatly into the front of my backpack.
cards.example_zh: 我的笔记本电脑正好能放进背包前面的隔层。
cards.explain_zh: laptop是便携电脑；desktop通常指台式电脑。

cards.example_en: The dentist checked my teeth and recommended a softer toothbrush.
cards.example_zh: 牙医检查了我的牙齿，并建议我用更软的牙刷。
cards.explain_zh: dentist指牙医；the dentist's可指牙医诊所。

cards.example_en: Her curly hair bounced as she ran upstairs.
cards.example_zh: 她跑上楼时，一头卷发随着步伐上下弹动。
cards.explain_zh: curly卷曲程度明显；wavy通常指轻柔的波浪状。

cards.example_en: Her curly hair bounced as she ran upstairs.
cards.example_zh: 她跑上楼时，一头卷发随着步伐上下弹动。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We walked around the harbour in Bristol yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 我们昨天在布里斯托尔的港口周围散了步。
cards.explain_zh: 重音在首音节；位于英格兰西南部。

cards.example_en: Our apartment is on the tenth floor of this building.
cards.example_zh: 我们的公寓在这栋楼的第十层。
cards.explain_zh: 第十通常用the tenth；十分之一用a tenth。

cards.example_en: Our apartment is on the tenth floor of this building.
cards.example_zh: 我们的公寓在这栋楼的第十层。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I marked our camping weekend on the kitchen calendar.
cards.example_zh: 我在厨房的日历上标出了周末露营的日子。
cards.explain_zh: calendar year指一月至十二月，不等于学年。

cards.example_en: She pulled a comb from her bag and tidied her hair.
cards.example_zh: 她从包里拿出梳子，梳理了一下头发。
cards.explain_zh: 词尾b不发音；comb through表示仔细搜查。

cards.example_en: We shared a park bench and watched the ducks.
cards.example_zh: 我们一起坐在公园长凳上看鸭子。
cards.explain_zh: 长凳常无靠背，但并非一定如此；工作台也可用bench。

cards.example_en: We shared a park bench and watched the ducks.
cards.example_zh: 我们一起坐在公园长凳上看鸭子。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We shared a delicious Thai curry for dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭我们一起吃了一道美味的泰式咖喱。
cards.explain_zh: Thai首字母始终大写；泰国是Thailand。

cards.example_en: Thai cuisine attracts international visitors and provides valuable opportunities for local restaurants and cooking schools.
cards.example_zh: 泰国菜吸引着国际游客，也为当地餐馆和烹饪学校提供了宝贵的机会。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Only a tenth of the survey participants regularly cycled to work, suggesting considerable scope for improving cycling infrastructure.
word.example_zh: 调查参与者中只有十分之一经常骑车上班，这说明自行车基础设施仍有很大的改善空间。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
